metadata.description: A sharp little toolkit of agent plugins — guided workflow, work folders + checkpoints, deep research, persistent memory.

plugins.name: guide
plugins.description: Toolkit map and composition guide (using-katana), injected at session start

plugins.name: work-folder
plugins.description: Work-folder convention (injected at session start) + checkpoint skill for cross-session save/resume

plugins.name: deep-research
plugins.description: Deep research over your local knowledge base (DEEP_RESEARCH_KB_DIR), the web, and any named sources declared in config — multi-round Workflow orchestration, judgment-driven stop, cited report

plugins.name: memory
plugins.description: Operational memory system for Claude Code — auto-injects verified facts as L1 index at session start, with skills for card lifecycle management

plugins.name: obsidian-md
plugins.description: Obsidian Markdown writing rules grounded in official docs — wikilinks, headings, frontmatter, embeds, callouts; never invent syntax

plugins.name: wiki
plugins.description: LLM-maintained wiki engine — schema-driven zones, provenance-enforced ingest, deterministic query ladder, adversarial lint

plugins.name: retrieval
plugins.description: Multi-source information retrieval — intent→source routing, credibility ladder, fallback chains; web/reddit/twitter/code/github/gitlab/linear/feishu/search-note adapters with externalized auth
